title: Cooktown Museum

buildingCutout.basis: Replace the generic four-sided convent outline with the verified museum shape.

terrainReference.basis: Original Queensland Government elevation at the west front approach.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap museum node and main outline
mapIdentity.scope: The museum point and exact main mapped rectangle coincide at 50 Helen Street. Queensland Heritage Register identifies the historic L-shaped plan, west gable and verandas. The simple native rectangle provides external bounds.

note: The dated institutional fabric and matched archive photo establish steep iron Gothic gable, paired columns, five veranda bays, arched brick windows, granite plinth and seven later dormers.
